text:
emma_cs: Quick QBR follow-up from Salmon Therapeutics — they listed three onboarding frictions and flagged renewal as a possible risk. Need a short triage so I can loop them back by EOW.

emma_cs: TL;DR: (A) no per-route cost visibility for internal chargeback, (B) streaming responses sometimes truncate mid-token on Dedicated, (C) onboarding doc/examples for VPC/KMS are sparse.

arjun_csm: Heard the same in the call. They said finance needs a CSV export and API to attach costs to product teams.

raj_pm: Can we score these by impact x effort? My guess: A=high impact, medium effort; B=high impact, high effort; C=medium impact, low effort.

maria_prod: Agree on the score. For A we could ship a minimal CSV export + UI filter first, then API. That buys time before a full per-route billing table.

jordan_eng: For B (streaming truncation) I need a small repro and the Dedicated pool config. Emma — can you grab a request id or a short curl example? Also want the pod logs around the time.

emma_cs: Yes — customer shared a snippet. Pasting anonymized request they used that hit the issue: 
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood-dedicated-8k",
  "stream": true,
  "input": "long transcript + instructions..."
}
```
They say it cuts off ~2.5k tokens into the stream occasionally.

jordan_eng: Thanks. Can you add the request ts + route name and I attach logs. Possible causes: continuous-batching boundary or client-side stream chunk handling.

kelly_enablement: I can draft a one-page onboarding checklist for VPC/KMS and a quick video walkthrough. That should reduce hand-holding while we work on A/B.

emma_cs: Perfect. For prioritization, customer said renewal decision in ~6 weeks. If we can promise a CSV export and a roadmap entry for API within 2 weeks, they be less worried.

arjun_csm: Marking as potential renewal risk in the CRM. I'll schedule a check-in after the CSV demo.

raj_pm: Action items: 1) Product to scope CSV + UI filter (maria) — ETA 2w. 2) Eng to triage streaming truncation and supply repro checklist (jordan) — ETA 5bd. 3) Enablement to produce VPC/KMS checklist (kelly) — ETA 3bd. 4) CS follow-up demo (arjun/emma) — schedule after CSV prototype.

maria_prod: I'll create a short RFC and attach mockups. Putting a label "cs-priority/salmon" on the epic.

ops-bot: Created ticket CI-4521: "Salmon: per-route CSV export (CS)" assigned to maria_prod, due 2 weeks. <https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CI-4521>

jordan_eng: One more ask: if anyone from the customer can reproduce reliably, ask them to toggle `stream: false` and send a sample full response — that helps rule out client-stream parsing.

emma_cs: I'll request that and post updates here. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
